classifications.rationale: The President presently and directly revokes the cited executive orders as applied to the specified Japanese and Korean persons, removing the executive-order basis that precluded their lawful entry or remaining; the legal consequence occurs in this segment itself.
classifications.evidence: I hereby revoke the said Executive Orders No. 589 of March 14, 1907, and No. 1712 of February 24, 1913

classifications.rationale: The Commissioner, subject to the Attorney General’s approval, is directed to take implementing action and issue any necessary regulations, but the segment does not dictate a particular later legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: to take such action and to issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary for carrying out the provisions of this order
